from pathlib import Path
paths=['src/orze/engine/native_post_script.py','src/orze/engine/evaluator.py','src/orze/engine/process_supervision.py','src/orze/engine/post_script_supervision.py','src/orze/engine/supervised_process.py','src/orze/engine/supervisor_worker.py','src/orze/engine/termination_hold.py','src/orze/engine/process.py','tests/test_native_post_script_tree_completion.py','tests/test_post_script_ready_go.py']

runs.name: independent_bounded_final
runs.command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
sources=['src/orze/engine/native_post_script.py','src/orze/engine/evaluator.py','src/orze/engine/process_supervision.py','src/orze/engine/post_script_supervision.py','src/orze/engine/supervised_process.py','src/orze/engine/supervisor_worker.py','src/orze/engine/termination_hold.py','src/orze/engine/process.py']
tests=['tests/test_post_script_ready_go.py','tests/test_native_post_script_tree_completion.py','tests/test_post_script_supervision_binding.py','tests/test_post_script_process_identity.py','tests/test_post_script_input_pinning.py','tests/test_post_script_launch_inputs.py','tests/test_post_script_skip_hold.py','tests/test_post_script_compute_context.py','tests/test_completion_event_authority.py','tests/test_evaluation_supervision_binding.py']
paths=sources+tests
before={p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}
print('PRE '+json.dumps(before),flush=True)
r=subprocess.run(['python3','-m','pytest','-q','-p','no:cacheprovider',*tests,'--tb=short'])
after={p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}
print('POST '+json.dumps(after),flush=True)
print('HASHES_EQUAL '+str(before==after),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(r.returncode)

findings: The source/command-derived historical action ID is unchanged. Current-source dependency and historical at-most-once dedup preserve repeated delivery and sequential script generations without upgrading old rows into new tree proof.

Fresh current action, accepted source, runtime, launch/resource/campaign and stop-authority checks precede GO. Persistent typed process_pid is checked against stored READY, then shared proof binds that READY to the actual captured handle.
READY start accounting and RUNNING publication happen inside the lease on the successful handoff path. GO occurs after leaving the lease, outside SQLite/effect writers.

Terminal requires actual whole-tree closure before and within the effect transaction, preserving exact return code and non-success STOP semantics. Only captured supervised ownership is used for cleanup.
Public pending-action gate precedes eligibility/output-exists skips. The old silent skip did not by itself prove that a second script launched; those are separate behavioral boundaries.
Legacy/tokenless branch is unchanged by this diff. Historical native unbound actions are not reconstructed or treated as closed from raw PID/exit code.
